text: The soured curd is cut, warmed a little to drain and pressed.

steps.note: The curd is left to drip in free-hanging bags in the traditional way; in industrial making, it is cut with strings, squeezed, cooled and packed.

processing.text: The curd is cut, warmed to 40-45 °C and drained.
